title: Processing a damaged-item return
body: When a customer reports an item damaged in transit, ask for a photo of the item and the packaging. Do not ask the customer to ship the item back first. Approve a replacement or refund straight away and raise a carrier claim within 7 days using the order number.

title: Refund approval limits
body: Support agents can approve refunds up to $200 without review. Refunds from $200 to $1,000 need a team lead. Anything above $1,000 goes to the finance queue and is usually decided within 2 business days.

title: Return labels during the holiday period
body: From 15 November to 31 December, return labels are valid for 45 days instead of 14. This applies to all orders shipped in the US.

title: Restocking returned power tools
body: Returned power tools are inspected within 3 days. Tools with an opened battery seal are sold as refurbished. Tools with missing blade guards are scrapped and the supplier is charged.
